title: kith-tslocal: Tailscale LocalAPI client
description: Implement the two LocalAPI calls kithd needs: WhoIs (per-request auth) and Status (tailnet IPs for binding). Only crate that talks to tailscaled.
notes: Review converged after 3 rounds. Final review: KITH-eg3. Bugs fixed: R2=missing I/O timeouts (P0), login_name null-byte check (P1), R3=streaming body size limit via http_body_util::Limited (P2). IPv6 addr encoding confirmed correct (not a bug). 14 tests (6 unit + 8 integration). Crate exports: LocalApiClient, DEFAULT_SOCKET, WhoIsResponse, UserProfile, WhoIsNode, StatusResponse.
